title: SALES EXECUTIVE

description:
**Sales Executive**

**Industry:** Commercial Refrigeration & Bakery Equipment  
**Job Location:** Kollam, Thrissur, Ernakulam, Thiruvananthapuram, and Alappuzha, Kerala  
**Salary:** ₹20,000 – ₹25,000 per month + Incentives  
**Number of Vacancies:** 8  
**Employment Type:** Full-time

M&G Recruitment is hiring Sales Executives on behalf of our client in the commercial refrigeration and bakery equipment industry. The ideal candidates should have good communication and interpersonal skills, a sales-oriented mindset, and the ability to develop customer relationships and generate business.

Key Responsibilities

* Identify and approach potential customers to generate new business opportunities.
* Promote and sell commercial refrigeration and bakery equipment.
* Visit customers, dealers, and businesses to understand their requirements.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective clients.
* Follow up on sales enquiries, prepare quotations, and support order closures.
* Achieve assigned sales targets and contribute to business growth.
* Monitor market trends and identify new sales opportunities in the assigned territory.

Requirements

* **Qualification:** Any Degree.
* **Experience:** 2 years of sales experience preferred; freshers can also apply.
* Good communication, negotiation, and customer-handling skills.
* Willingness to travel within the assigned location for customer visits.
* **A two-wheeler is mandatory.**
* Immediate joiners preferred.

Salary & Benefits

* Monthly salary of ₹20,000 – ₹25,000, based on experience and suitability.
* Performance-based incentives.
* Opportunity to develop sales experience in a specialised equipment industry.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can apply through Indeed or share their updated CV at:

**Email:** recruiter@mandgworld.com  
**Contact:** +91 90725 74517

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month
